hana (DevEx): Quick report from an onboarding session with the next-rag-quickstart template. Two friction points: 1) telemetry labels the failure as 'network' but the root is auth retry; 2) the starter's retry defaults cause the UI to show partial + duplicate paragraphs. Repro steps attached.

omar (SDK): Can you paste the tiny repro and logs?

hana (DevEx): Repro (minimal): run the starter, open chat, force a 401 from the proxy on first generate then allow token refresh. Logs: ```
[2025-06-18T11:04:12Z] proxy -> /v1/generate 401 {"msg":"invalid"}
[2025-06-18T11:04:12Z] sdk.retry auth -> waiting backoff
[2025-06-18T11:04:22Z] proxy -> /v1/generate 200 (stream start)
[2025-06-18T11:04:22Z] frontend: received partial chunk
[2025-06-18T11:04:22Z] frontend: received full stream (duplicate)
```
Behavior: Console telemetry shows event.category="network_error" which hid the auth root cause during triage. Also the UI concatenated partial+replayed stream.

lee (Observability): Thanks, that's useful. We map HTTP codes to broad categories; auth 401 was collapsing into network_error because the retry path masked the original header. We can tweak parser to tag the initial status when retry detected (event.subtype="auth_retry"). Will add a small change to Console parsing.

omar (SDK): On the SDK side, we missed preserving the original response meta when replaying streaming calls. Plan: 1) detect streaming endpoints and if any bytes emitted -> treat auth (401/403) as non-retryable; 2) preserve and emit a telemetry hint 'stream_replay' when we do replay to help obs. I'll open a small patch and cut a canary.

tess (Docs): I'll add a short Troubleshooting entry in the quickstart README: explain telemetry signals, how to set retry.maxRetries=0 for streaming proxy routes, and a tiny UI dedupe snippet for the starter. Suggested blurb: "If you see duplicate paragraphs after an auth refresh, try disabling retries for streaming endpoints or upgrade to SDK v0.11.3+ which fixes stream replay handling."

ci-bot: Buildkite: job #7724 queued for branch next-rag-quickstart-fixes :gear:

hana (DevEx): Quick workaround I used during the session: in the starter proxy route set `retry: { maxRetries: 0 }` and add server-side dedupe by runId. That made the demo resilient for new users.

omar (SDK): Great — I'll post the canary and PR link here. Also adding an e2e in the starter harness that simulates 401->200 stream to catch regressions.

hana (DevEx): Thanks folks. Once canary is published we'll bump the template and update onboarding checklist so new devs don't get blocked. :sparkles:
